name: opencode-mnemon
description: OpenCode plugin: project-scoped automatic memory via mnemon CLI (runtime capture, rule + LLM extraction, recall/status injection)

scripts.test: sh tests/build-mnemon-test.sh && node scripts/sync-docs.mjs --check && node tests/mnemon-recall-gate-test.mjs && node tests/mnemon-extract-test.mjs && node tests/mnemon-remember-e2e.mjs && node tests/mnemon-llm-extract-test.mjs && node tests/mnemon-init-test.mjs
scripts.test:deploy: sh tests/build-mnemon-test.sh "$PWD/mnemon.js" && node scripts/sync-docs.mjs --check && node tests/mnemon-recall-gate-test.mjs && node tests/mnemon-extract-test.mjs && node tests/mnemon-remember-e2e.mjs && node tests/mnemon-llm-extract-test.mjs && node tests/mnemon-init-test.mjs
